newsitem.title: POLAND: Fiat launches Siena model in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Fiat launches Siena model in Europe.

text.p: Italy's Fiat SpA launched on Thursday its compact Siena model in Europe at an automotive fair in the Polish city of Poznan.
The global launch of the car was held early this month in Argentina where it has been produced since December. Poland will be the model's only production centre in Europe.
Carlo Poggi, commercial director of Fiat Auto Poland, the carmaker's Polish unit, told a news conference the company planned to make up to 50,000 Sienas at its Bielsko-Biala plant in southern Poland.
Fiat's Argentinian plant is expected to reach an output of 120,000 Sienas next year.
Poggi said Fiat planned to invest 210 million zlotys over 1997-1998 in the production of the new model in the Polish plant.
Fiat also has under production in Poland the subcompact Cinquecento model and the 126 minicar.
Massimo Gentilini, the head of Fiat Auto Poland, said the company expected to maintain its close to 40 percent market share this year and planned to invest 800 million zlotys in 1997-2002.
